description: Use this when the user wants a reply to one buying signal, such as "draft a reply to the first post" after find_buying_intent. Pass service and signal, one find_buying_intent or weekly_brief result as it came, for example {"service": "SEO audit", "signal": {"source": "hackernews", "url": "https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=1", "date": "2026-10-20", "label": "intent", "signals": ["looking for"]}}. Returns a 3-line draft, the reason to reply now, and checks before sending. Plain rules, no AI model. Draft only: it sends nothing, opens no link, has no recipient and fills in no name. Not for finding leads (use find_buying_intent).

service.description: The service you sell, as in find_buying_intent, such as "SEO audit"

signal.description: One result from find_buying_intent or weekly_brief, passed as it came. Only its source, url, date, label and signals are read; the quote is ignored

url.description: The https link of the result

name: draft_follow_up

draft.description: The three lines joined by line breaks, to edit and send yourself

lead_source.description: The buying-signal source to store with a reply sent from this draft

lines.description: The draft in three lines: the opener, the useful line, the disclosure or easy close

notice.description: What the draft is and is not. Pass it on

reason.description: One line on why this lead has a reason to reply now

sent.description: Always false: this tool sends nothing

title: Draft a follow-up with a reason to reply
